dataset: Extension of Z-Alizadeh Sani (UCI Machine Learning Repository, id 411), CC BY 4.0
structure: P(CAD) = Platt(RF); P(vessel) = P(CAD) x Platt(RF trained on CAD patients)

evaluation.protocol: Stratified 5-fold CV repeated 10 times (seeds 0-9); forest, Platt calibrator, threshold and vessel models fitted inside training folds only; DeLong 95% CIs averaged over repeats.

prereg.inputs: age, sex, cp, trestbps, chol (0 = missing), fbs, restecg; no missing-value indicators
prereg.validation: leave one hospital out: train on 4 hospitals, test on the 5th, for all 5
prereg.selection_rule: highest mean AUC over the 5 held-out hospitals; if within 0.01, choose the simpler model

flowstate_rule_out_cut_off.source: evaluate.py: 10x repeated nested 5-fold CV, cut-off chosen inside the training folds

notes: ESC classes: under-30s use the 30-39 row; patients with no chest pain and no dyspnoea get the non-anginal (lowest) value.
The CAD Consortium score is also one of flowstate's inputs; flowstate adds ECG, echo and laboratory information on top of it.

heldout_curves.note: held-out predictions from one stratified 5-fold split (train.py)
